description: Inspect or create mouth controls on an OWNED GLB while preserving its body skeleton and animations. action=schema returns the contract. inspect returns a persistent job with mesh node indices, local bounds, existing facial controls and compatible dialogue.voice mappings. build automatically reuses recognized Oculus/ARKit/Rhubarb controls, or creates eight draft mouth morphs from explicit mouth landmarks (profile) or measurements on the asset itself (auto_landmarks=true). A sealed mouth requires explicit prepare_mouth=true to cut a guided opening on the output copy and add an interior; it interpolates UVs and skin weights, changes face topology and requires visual review. It never guesses landmarks from the body bounds. Poll gripforge_generation_read for the new private GLB, report, voice_rig JSON and Character Studio link. No automatic source replacement or project binding. No TTS/GPU rental; CPU geometry processing, not full facial expression authoring. review_clip optionally names a body animation to create eight fixed-pose review clips.

auto_landmarks.description: Measure mouth landmarks on projections of the actual asset. Returns a mesh-local profile during inspect, or uses it for build. Requires an upright textured human face. Existing compatible controls are reused. Review the result.

face_controls.description: Build only: portable eyelid, eye-direction and expression morphs around generated eye spheres. Original body clips remain unchanged. review_clip also adds opt-in facial performance exercises; no automatic engine behaviour.

front.description: Optional body front hint for automatic landmark detection.

mouth_parts.description: Build only: optional starter teeth and/or tongue fitted to the measured mouth before new controls are authored. Rigid jaw motion preserves tooth shapes. Review placement and occlusion. Existing rigs are reused; missing parts are reported rather than added to them.

node.description: Mesh node index from inspect. Selects one existing rig when independent faces use different conventions.

prepare_mouth.description: Opt in to cutting a guided opening and adding an inner mouth on the output copy when the mouth is sealed. Requires profile or auto_landmarks and no existing morphs. Supports multiple materials. During automatic inspection this only measures a preparation profile; it writes no geometry.

profile.description: For a model without mouth controls: front-view left/right mouth corners, distinct upper/lower INNER lip points and chin, all in the selected node LOCAL rest space before skinning/transforms. A sealed surface also requires prepare_mouth. Inspect first; do not guess from whole-body bounds. depth optionally limits the region behind the lips.

refine_surface.description: Build only, before new morphs: bounded rest-surface smoothing between measured eyes and lips. Protects eye rims, lips and body. Existing morphs are preserved with a warning.

review_clip.description: Optional body animation name. Adds eight separate review clips with fixed mouth poses and the same body motion. No automatic playback or speech.
